notes: Grades are closer to real slab grades. Tested on 79 of Rom's and Roger's cards, 12 of them with a real PSA, AGS or CGC grade.
Dark full-art cards on the black background: the parts that can be seen are measured now, and the grade leans lower when part of a card can't be seen.
New: Which background? on Grade a card, and a Scan it again button when part of a card blends into the background. Both scans are combined into one grade.
A faded yellow border on older cards is caught now, and the same card scanned on white and on black gets the same grade.
